items.title: Could JetBlue Become the Next U.S. Airline to Face Bankruptcy?
items.snippet: JetBlue faces mounting financial pressure as creditors hire restructuring advisers, bond prices plunge and fuel costs soar, raising questions about its turnaround strategy, liquidity and the airline’s long-term survival prospects.

items.title: Beaten-Down JetBlue Shares Rebound as Carrier Says 2027 Profit Is on Track
items.snippet: Skift Take: JetBlue shares rebounded after market on Monday after the carrier reaffirmed its long-term profit goals. JetBlue cut its 2026 outlook and posted a wider third-quarter loss Monday, but said it remains on track to return to sustained profitability in 2027.

items.title: From Long Lines to Warm Welcomes: How Mangia's Modernized the Guest Journey With Canary
items.snippet: Mangia's 16-property Italian group cut check-in time by 10 minutes per guest and unlocked net-new revenue by deploying Canary's mobile check-in, AI messaging, and dynamic upsell tools.

items.title: Shree Naman Group completes acquisition of JW Marriott Bengaluru and Crowne Plaza Pune
items.snippet: JW Marriott Bengaluru and Crowne Plaza Pune join a growing hospitality portfolio with five operating hotels and three under development. Going forward, Shree Naman Group will continue to pursue a dual growth strategy, combining acquisitions of operating hotels with greenfield developments on its existing land parcels and mixed-use projects, particularly in Mumbai.

items.title: Travel + Leisure Co. expands Eddie Bauer Adventure Club to Texas Hill Country
items.snippet: Located outside of Austin, the brand’s first “Outpost” property will feature geodomes, yurts and cabins, as travelers continue to crave nature-oriented experiences. The upcoming Outpost in Texas will feature fire pits, outdoor camp kitchens, an onsite trail and yard games including bocce ball and pickleball. Additionally, the property’s existing event space will become an owners’ lounge with self-serve retail.

items.title: ITC Hotels Limited registers strong performance: Continued momentum in growth and expansion for Q2 FY27
items.snippet: The company recorded consolidated revenue from operations at Rs 1,054 crore up 26 percent, EBITDA at Rs 337 crore up 37 percent, and PAT at Rs 203 crore up 52 percent. Standalone revenue from operation at Rs 885 crore up 16 percent, EBITDA at Rs 301 crore up 28 percent, and PAT at Rs 207 crore up 37 percent and Standalone operating ROCE at 20 percent, increased by 310 bps, according to a release.

items.title: RWS strengthens Indian trade partnerships through networking
items.snippet: Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) has concluded two travel trade networking evenings in India, held in New Delhi on October 6 and Mumbai on October 8, 2026. The events brought together the resort’s Regional Sales & Marketing and MICE representatives with Indian travel trade partners to share destination updates, strengthen collaboration and introduce a limited-period incentive for eligible leisure bookings from India.

items.title: Air India Express launches direct Kochi-Bangkok flights
items.snippet: Air India Express has launched direct flights between Kochi and Bangkok, strengthening air connectivity between Kerala and Thailand. The new service commenced operations on October 25, 2026, as part of the airline’s largest-ever Winter Schedule 2026. The route adds a non-stop international connection for travellers from Kerala and expands the airline’s growing network across South and Southeast Asia.

items.title: Brigade Group and Hyatt Announce Plans for Two New Hyatt Regency Hotels in Bengaluru
items.snippet: Brigade Group today announced the signing of management agreements with Hyatt Hotels Corporation for two new hotels in Bengaluru: Hyatt Regency Bengaluru at Brigade Global Park and Hyatt Regency Bengaluru at Brigade’s upcoming integrated township on Whitefield-Kadugodi Road. Together, the two hotels are expected to add 600 rooms to Brigade’s hotel portfolio in Bengaluru.

items.title: Shangri-La Eros fined INR 1 lakh over service charge
items.snippet: The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has imposed a penalty of INR 1 lakh on Mister Chai, the restaurant at Shangri-La Eros New Delhi, for automatically levying a 10% service charge without customers’ explicit consent. In an order dated October 22, the regulator held that the practice violated consumer rights and constituted an unfair trade practice under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
